title: Fixed Part Raised Auditorium Seat
description: One original complete fixed floor-mounted auditorium seat with two whole cast-style floor standards, broad fixing soles and rear back supports, two armrests, a separate broad back shell/cushion and one distinct thick seat pan/cushion held at 56 degrees on a full transverse pivot axle and end bosses. A fixed pan underside counterbalance exterior is visible; no actuation is provided. This is not a crossed-frame canvas camp chair or a continuous cantilever dining shell tilted as a whole: only the separate seat rises between fixed standards and back. All whole geometry is newly authored, three opaque PBR materials, metre scale and true XY-centred ground origin; one static model, no scene or occupant. No automatic return, spring force, human fit, seating comfort, load, installation, aisle clearance, fire or safety compliance claim.
